caption: The drawing depicts a single blue pitcher with a curved handle, placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The pitcher is rendered in a soft blue tone with lighter highlights suggesting reflections and shine, indicating a metallic or glazed surface. The handle is ornate, with a slight curl at the upper and lower ends, attached near the top and middle of the pitcher’s body. The vessel itself has a wide, rounded body that narrows towards the neck and then flares out to form a lip or spout at the top. The base is sturdy and slightly flared, supporting the weight of the vessel. There are no other objects, patterns, or embellishments present in the drawing, and the background remains uniformly pale, with minor variations in shading and a faint signature that reads “David P. Willoughby” located to the right and just below the pitcher.
title: Silver Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
